name: Attack speed icon
description: Passive icon: double chevron pointing right. Port of the hand-drawn i_speed from Feelers' BootScene. Rim is `$chitin`, the same as `ss.icon.boomerang`: this passive is the Mandible evolution's other half, so the pair reads as a pair on the bar. The glyph wears the rim's colour as well, so the passive is one colour on the bar.
